title: God-conscious Being Lives Forever, And Does Not
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 273
summary: This shabad opens with the God-conscious being lives forever, and does not die. It turns the heart toward o Nanak, the God-conscious being is the Lord of all.
whyItMatters: It matters when life feels isolated, impressionable, and needing-company because the shabad keeps sangat inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private momentum.
takeaway: Keep returning to this turn: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is the Lord of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee sabh sirasaT kaa karataa ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being is the Creator of all the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee sadh jeevai nahee marataa ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being lives forever, and does not die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee mukat jugat jeea kaa dhaataa ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being is the Giver of the way of liberation of the soul.
The God-conscious being is the Perfect Supreme Being, who orchestrates all.
The God-conscious being is the helper of the helpless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee kaa sabh uoopar haath ||
lines.translation: The God-conscious being extends his hand to all.
The God-conscious being owns the entire creation.
The God-conscious being is himself the Formless Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham giaanee kee sobhaa braham giaanee banee ||
lines.translation: The glory of the God-conscious being belongs to the God-conscious being alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਧਨੀ ॥੮॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak braham giaanee sarab kaa dhanee ||8||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the God-conscious being is the Lord of all. ||8||8||

structure: It opens by naming the condition without ornament: the God-conscious being lives forever, and does not die.
The middle movement widens the correction through the God-conscious being extends his hand to all.
It closes with a return you can actually keep: o Nanak, the God-conscious being is the Lord of all.
